description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: The Census Bureau's own prose describing each industry, carried as free text and NULL where a code defers to its child. Inferred, finetype labels this column `unknown`, and an `unknown` field publishes no length bounds at all; the column is prose, so plain text is what it is.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: A derived search field: title and description, lowercased, accent-stripped and concatenated. It is free text by construction, not a source attribute. Inferred, finetype labels it `unknown` and it publishes no length bounds.
